title: Mathematician sees DMT entities solving the four color theorem instantly

tellings.quote: right. Uh, and yet these entities they they [snorts] do it instantaneously like less than a second and they do it repeatedly.

plain: A mathematician named Andress is said to have seen beings, while on DMT, a very strong psychedelic drug, solve the four color theorem, a hard maths problem about colouring any map with four colours so no neighbours match, in under a second, over and over. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore tells this as what the mathematician reported to him. To Gallimore it suggests the beings met on DMT have minds far beyond ours.
